simple.text: The cat sat on the mat.

simple.text: Water boils at one hundred degrees.
simple.note: 事実文。固有名詞なし、明確な意味。

complex.text: Although it was raining heavily, John decided to walk to the library to return the books he had borrowed last week.

trajectory.text: Although it was raining heavily, John decided to walk to the library to return the books he had borrowed last week.

ambiguous.note: 古典的曖昧構文。'like' の品詞解釈で軌跡が変わる。

trajectory.text: Time flies like an arrow; fruit flies like a banana.

ambiguous.text: The chicken is ready to eat.
